repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-locus
repository.purpose: Internal Webex JS SDK plugin for the Locus call and meeting state service. It registers webex.internal.locus, wraps the Locus REST operations (create, join, alert, decline, leave, get, list, sync, media update, DTMF, and floor grant) and the Janus call-history query, compares Locus sequence objects to decide whether an incoming Locus DTO replaces, is ignored, or requires a fetch, merges Locus delta DTOs into a caller-held working copy, and exports the list of Locus event names.

locus-sdk.summary: Published npm package. main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.js. Importing the package imports @webex/internal-plugin-mercury for its side effect and registers Locus as the internal plugin 'locus' with no config. The barrel src/index.js exports Locus as default, eventKeys from src/event-keys.js, and the constants USE_INCOMING, USE_CURRENT, EQUAL, FETCH, GREATER_THAN, LESS_THAN, and DESYNC from src/locus.js. Per-method behavior is in src/docs/README.md.

locus-service-http.source: Locus service REST API (catalog service 'locus' and the URLs carried in Locus DTOs)
locus-service-http.summary: Consumed, not served. Calls POST loci/call and GET loci on service locus; POST <locus.url>/participant; PUT <locus.url>/participant/alert and /participant/decline; GET <locus.url>; GET <locus.syncUrl>; PUT <locus.self.url>/leave and /media; POST <locus.self.url>/sendDtmf; PUT <share.url> with a floor body. Request bodies are listed under Protocol and wire format in src/docs/README.md.

janus-history-http.summary: Consumed, not served. getCallHistory calls GET history/userSessions on service janus with query from set to an ISO-8601 timestamp.

webex-core-plugin-host.summary: Host contract consumed by Locus: WebexPlugin.extend supplies this.webex and request(), which delegates to webex.request; registerInternalPlugin installs the plugin; WebexHttpError.Conflict is the 409 subtype built by the sibling http-core makeSubTypes and is checked in decline and leave.

webex-device-registration.summary: Locus reads webex.internal.device.url as the deviceUrl in request bodies. The device plugin is not a declared dependency of this package; it is registered transitively because src/index.js imports @webex/internal-plugin-mercury, whose index imports the device plugin.

mercury-sdk.summary: Imported only for its registration side effect in src/index.js. Locus calls no Mercury method and subscribes to no Mercury event. Owned and specified by @webex/internal-plugin-mercury.

lodash.summary: src/locus.js imports cloneDeep (merge), difference, first, last, and memoize (compareSequence).

uuid.summary: uuid.v4 generates the dtmf.correlationId in sendDtmf.

The package serves no HTTP routes. It is a client of the Locus and Janus services, recorded as the external internal-publication contracts locus-service-http and janus-history-http; its published surface is the npm export described by locus-sdk.
No package-level security policy exists. The workspace root SECURITY.md is not overwritten and a per-package copy would duplicate it.
